concern: Living with a lifelong illness, feeling hopeless that life will never improve, and feeling alone with no one to turn to.
first_advice: "Is it possible that even though your illness is chronic, that it goes through phases..." opens the reply by pushing a cognitive reframe.
acknowledged_before_advice: Nothing. The brief validation ("frustrating and can be depressing to think about") only comes after the opening reframe, and the loneliness is never acknowledged.
label: premature
